lanes.title: Width-two joint scalar multiplication oracle
lanes.mechanism: Use a shared base-4 table for [a]G+[b]Q and retain separate scalar multiplication as the oracle.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Compare every coefficient pair in a bounded subgroup against two independent scalar multiplications.
lanes.measurement_gate: Cold setup and whole-run comparison after checkpoint and isolation admission.

lanes.title: Cold joint-table construction batching
lanes.mechanism: Construct the thirteen nontrivial table entries in complete-addition layers sharing denominators.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Compare all sixteen entries with independently computed iG+jQ and require the frozen 13-add, 3-batch-inversion identity.
lanes.measurement_gate: Counted recomposition followed by isolated setup profile.

lanes.title: Reuse the joint table for initial walkers
lanes.mechanism: Evaluate initial [a]G+[b]Q walkers through the already cold-charged table instead of two independent scalar multiplications.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Force an infinity first attempt and require equal accepted point, coefficients, canonical representative, RNG cursor, and attempts.
lanes.measurement_gate: Lower complete setup cost with unchanged walk and verification records.

lanes.title: Lane-ordered retry-preserving walker batches
lanes.mechanism: Batch arithmetic without reordering the sequential coefficient stream when any lane reaches infinity.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A scripted infinity retry must consume exactly the same next pair as the scalar baseline.
lanes.measurement_gate: Multi-lane forced-exception corpus plus complete cold accounting.

lanes.title: Charge discarded setup attempts
lanes.mechanism: Retain arithmetic, RNG draws, and group additions for every rejected infinity candidate.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A one-retry fixture must report two attempts, one discard, and four coefficient draws.
lanes.measurement_gate: Analyzer rejects any record whose attempts and charged work disagree.

lanes.title: RNG-state equivalence receipt
lanes.mechanism: Record the post-setup RNG cursor/state and compare baseline and candidate exactly.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Baseline and joint-table construction must finish at the same scripted cursor after forced retries.
lanes.measurement_gate: All q-grid setup records carry and match the bound RNG-state digest.

lanes.title: Joint-window width sweep
lanes.mechanism: Compare widths two, three, and four after charging table construction and sparse top windows.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Every width returns the scalar-oracle point for boundary and seeded coefficient pairs.
lanes.measurement_gate: Training-only selection and one-shot holdout setup cost.

lanes.title: Joint sparse-form recoding
lanes.mechanism: Screen signed joint sparse form for fewer additions while charging digit generation and signed table entries.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Recode reconstructs both scalars and returns the exact reference point for all boundary scalars.
lanes.measurement_gate: Cold counted setup improves after recoding overhead and table construction.

lanes.title: Fixed-base G precomputation split
lanes.mechanism: Reuse a cold-charged fixed-base table for G while retaining a per-target table for Q.
prerequisites: explicit cold versus reusable accounting interval
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Fixed and joint paths return identical points and verification scalars.
lanes.measurement_gate: Report cold one-target cost separately from any explicitly amortized experiment.

lanes.title: Cross-walker denominator batching
lanes.mechanism: Share affine inversions across a layer of independent initial-walker joint multiplications.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Adversarial infinity lanes preserve sequential acceptance and charge all discarded layers.
lanes.measurement_gate: Setup field counts fall without changing RNG, accepted walkers, or downstream trajectory.

lanes.title: Exception-complete affine batch addition
lanes.mechanism: Batch ordinary and tangent denominators while handling infinity and opposite-point cases explicitly.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Corpus covers infinity, doubling, inverse pairs, and distinct affine pairs against the oracle.
lanes.measurement_gate: No exceptional fallback is uncharged in complete setup records.

lanes.title: Exceptional-case mask compaction
lanes.mechanism: Compact ordinary additions into one batch while retaining explicit charged fallback lanes.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Permuted exceptional corpora reproduce lane-wise oracle outputs and counts.
lanes.measurement_gate: Allocation and branch diagnostics improve without changing field counts.

lanes.title: Projective setup-only scalar multiplication
lanes.mechanism: Keep Horner layers projective and batch-normalize accepted outputs once.
prerequisites: complete formulas over the admitted curve
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Affine-normalized output equals the reference across exceptional and random coefficients.
lanes.measurement_gate: Source-bound profile first; retain only if total setup cost falls.

lanes.title: X-only setup and recovery screen
lanes.mechanism: Evaluate x-only simultaneous multiplication only with a certified sign/coefficient recovery path.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Recover the exact affine subgroup point and coefficients for every test input.
lanes.measurement_gate: No implementation promotion before the functional-state and collision obligations are discharged.

lanes.title: Setup subgroup-membership checks
lanes.mechanism: Verify G, Q, jump entries, and accepted walkers are on-curve and annihilated by the named subgroup order.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Reject an off-curve point and a point outside the named subgroup.
lanes.measurement_gate: Checks execute in replay/validation; any online exclusion is stated and charged consistently.

lanes.title: Independent setup equation verifier
lanes.mechanism: Recompute P=[a]G+[b]Q with the scalar oracle rather than the candidate joint path.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Tampered point or coefficient pair fails the equation.
lanes.measurement_gate: Every measured setup sample is replayable from bound coefficients and curve identity.

lanes.title: Cold setup composition gate
lanes.mechanism: Compose accepted setup changes once and compare the complete phase record to the frozen baseline.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Same coefficients, accepted walkers, RNG digest, trajectory, collision scalar, and recovered secret.
lanes.measurement_gate: Only the recomposed binary may enter A/A, ABAB, holdout, and frontier runs.
